index.title: Join TiE Siliguri
index.summary: Become part of the world's largest network of entrepreneurs — right here in North Bengal. Two ways to join, one shared mission: helping entrepreneurs become better entrepreneurs.
intro: TiE membership is your entry into a global ecosystem of mentors, founders and investors — and into an active local chapter running curated sessions every month.
Members join as either Charter Members or Associate Members. Both plug into the same community; the difference is the depth of access, governance and global privileges.

items.body: Continuous learning through workshops, masterclasses, webinars and global events — insights from industry leaders and experienced entrepreneurs.

items.title: Mentor & Support
items.body: Unmatched mentorship from successful entrepreneurs and thought leaders, guiding you through every stage of the journey.

items.title: Network & Collaborate
items.body: Access to a global network of entrepreneurs, investors and professionals — opportunities for collaboration, partnerships and growth.

items.title: Fund & Incubate
items.body: Help securing funding through programs like TiE Angels, connecting startups with investors and structured acceleration.

items.title: Personal & professional growth
items.body: Sharpen your entrepreneurial skills through global-level mentoring and learning.

items.title: Global connectivity
items.body: Leverage TiE's international network for business opportunities and collaborations.

items.title: Impactful mentorship
items.body: Access mentorship from proven entrepreneurs dedicated to your success.

items.title: Leadership opportunities
items.body: Grow your influence, give back, and shape the future of entrepreneurship through active roles.

items.name: TiE Young Entrepreneurs (TYE)
items.body: Nurturing young entrepreneurial talent through real-world business challenges and mentorship.

items.name: TiE University
items.body: Empowering university entrepreneurs with the tools, network and mentorship to bring ideas to market.

items.name: TiE Women
items.body: Accelerating women-led enterprises with mentorship, networking and funding.

items.name: TiE Nurture

items.name: TiE Members Retreat

benefits.title: What you get as a member
benefits.summary: From a global network and world-class mentorship to a full local calendar of learning and connection — here's what membership brings.

items.title: A global network
items.body: Connect with entrepreneurs, investors and professionals across 64 chapters in 14 countries.

items.title: Mentorship that moves you forward
items.body: Guidance from founders and operators who have already built at scale.

items.title: Continuous learning
items.body: Practitioner-led masterclasses, workshops and webinars — at least one session every month.

items.title: Funding pathways
items.body: Routes to angel capital and investor readiness through TiE Angels and the wider investing network.

items.title: Global event access
items.body: Charter Members attend any TiE chapter's events worldwide for free — including TiECons and the TiE Global Summit.

items.title: Recognition & visibility
items.body: Profile in TiE Global directories and chapter collateral, strengthening your personal and professional brand.

items.title: Leadership & giving back
items.body: Eligibility for Executive Committee, SIG Chair and program-leader roles that shape the ecosystem.

items.title: A local community
items.body: Monthly mixers, coffee meets and mentoring clinics with North Bengal's founders.

categories.title: Charter Member or Associate Member
categories.summary: Both categories join the same community. Charter Membership is by invitation and carries voting rights, governance and global privileges; Associate Membership is an open, inclusive way in.

definitions.name: Charter Member (CM)
definitions.body: Distinguished entrepreneurs and visionary business leaders who guide the strategic direction of the chapter. CMs exclusively hold voting rights and are eligible for leadership positions — Executive Committee, SIG Chairs and program leaders — influencing TiE's mission locally and globally.

definitions.name: Associate Member (AM)
definitions.body: Aspiring entrepreneurs and professionals who benefit from extensive learning, mentorship and networking. AMs don't hold voting rights or leadership positions, but engage actively in chapter activities as volunteers to accelerate their growth.

apply.title: Become a member
apply.summary: Joining TiE Siliguri is a short conversation away. Tell us a little about you and the chapter team will guide you through the right membership for your stage.

items.title: Reach out
items.body: Email or call the chapter team, or send us your details — whichever is easiest.

items.title: Find your fit
items.body: We'll help you choose between Charter and Associate Membership based on your stage and goals.

items.title: Confirm & onboard
items.body: Complete your membership and get onboarded into the chapter, its events and the global network.
